finalSha: recorded in the release handoff after the final commit
scope: Phase 5 release-candidate validation only; Phase 6 was not started.

deployment.finding: The available Vercel account context contains only an unrelated project (excenor-ai-maturity-poc); no ANUMA Vercel project was linked or deployed.
deployment.requiredFounderAction: Import or reconnect SakshamS11/anumaai in the correct Vercel team, configure the named server/public environment variables securely, and deploy main.

security.result: All scenarios passed with rolled-back fixtures, including organization isolation, representative peer restrictions, manager scoped review, admin management, private storage, review objects, and append-only correction roles.

desktop.evidence: Chromium public responsive regression at 1440 x 900 passed.

androidPhoneEmulation.evidence: Public responsive regression passed at 360 x 800, 390 x 844, and 412 x 915. The authenticated interaction creation, setup, persistence, sign-out, and small-screen navigation journey passed with the Pixel 5 profile.
androidPhoneEmulation.limitation: Chromium viewport emulation is not a physical Android device.

androidTabletEmulation.evidence: Public responsive regression passed at 600 x 960, 768 x 1024, 800 x 1280, and 1024 x 768 using a touch/tablet profile.
androidTabletEmulation.limitation: Physical portrait and landscape validation remains required.

changes: best-effort echo cancellation, noise suppression, auto gain control, and mono constraints with a capability-safe fallback
normalization of MediaRecorder MIME parameters such as audio/webm;codecs=opus before server validation
elapsed recording status, screen-awake guidance, before-unload warning, and duplicate save protection
audioCapture.physicalDeviceRequired: A real Android microphone, preview, upload interruption, and screen-lock check remain required.

sarvamRealAudio.finding: No human-recorded English or Hinglish audio fixture was available in this environment. A real Sarvam run was not fabricated from a pre-written transcript.
sarvamRealAudio.requiredManualAcceptance: Record one English-heavy and one Hinglish role-play through the browser path, then capture duration, latency, diarization, timestamps, critical entities, and obvious errors.

speakerMapping.evidence: Hosted review acceptance uses explicit representative/customer mapping and all metrics derive from mapped transcript roles; provider labels are never assumed.
speakerMapping.physicalDeviceRequired: Validate two-plus live diarized speakers after a real Sarvam run.

lunaUnderstanding.evidence: Retained multilingual live acceptance: English, Light Hinglish, and Heavy Hinglish are validated for current scope; source evidence remains original language and normalized output remains English.
lunaUnderstanding.limitation: Hindi remains experimental and real Sarvam-to-Luna validation awaits human-recorded audio.

evidence.evidence: Hosted review proof validated positive/partial evidence IDs against the same organization, conversation, and transcription run; absence evidence is not fabricated.

rules: interaction duration uses mapped transcript span
talk-share denominator is representative plus customer only
additional_customer joins customer; manager and unknown are excluded
same-role chunks merge at a gap of 250 ms or less
word count and estimated WPM use one whitespace-token implementation
zero bilateral speech omits talk-share rows

review.retainedFixture: Synthetic Heavy Hinglish input with retained live Phase 4 output; hosted database review result.
review.repeatability: Deterministic checks remained stable. Semantic outcomes varied on the greeting check between immutable historical runs (met versus insufficient_evidence); the release repeat matched the original 83.33% result.

coaching.result: Deterministic strengths for budget and requirement understanding; one evidence-linked price-comparison opportunity. No coaching model call, personality inference, policy claim, or invented price claim.

corrections.result: The product now exposes a safe correction proposal and manager/admin confirmation or rejection path. Hosted RLS acceptance proves representative proposal, cross-tenant denial, representative review denial, and in-scope manager confirmation without source overwrite.
corrections.reEvaluation: Manual review requests remain explicit and create immutable runs rather than modifying prior check or scorecard rows.

idempotency.result: Client double-save protection and duplicate-current-run database protections are present; zero-observation analysis lineage and review-history acceptance are covered by existing targeted tests and hosted runs.
idempotency.physicalDeviceRequired: Founder should double-tap recording, save/process, understanding, and review during device testing.

networkRecovery.finding: Safe user-facing failures and workflow-start recovery are implemented, but actual mobile upload interruption/background behavior requires human device validation.

expectedPath.semanticReview: zero or one batched request per review run

knownLimitations: Physical Android phone and tablet validation remains required.
No verified ANUMA Vercel deployment is linked in the available account context.
No human-recorded English/Hinglish Sarvam acceptance audio was available in this environment.
Semantic review can vary across independently immutable runs.
No offline mode, background-recording guarantee, native app, outcomes, aggregate intelligence, or Phase 6 capability is included.
